recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-40294 unless a future work group decision changes operation-based message event guidance or computable event-definition wording.
issue_request: FHIR-40294 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification and asked to clarify the Messaging page statement about MessageHeader.event so it says the event can be computably defined by MessageDefinition or OperationDefinition, not GraphDefinition or EventDefinition for the transmitted-resource description.
initial_application: Commit 48603ec9f67f91177955f8470fed7caad80596e4 added the MessageDefinition/OperationDefinition wording to source/messaging.html while applying FHIR-40294 with nearby messaging issues. Commit c29dd25e3dba4b3f8be23e19a982e083b5f6883c then removed explanation-only GraphDefinition/EventDefinition prose, leaving the approved computable-definition wording.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes messaging.html in the build navigation, and current source/messaging.html contains the requested wording. The MessageHeader.element definition can still allow EventDefinition or SubscriptionTopic as event identifiers because FHIR-40294 was about computably describing the resources to transmit. FHIR-43942 was the later same-change-family application tracker and is already audited on the combined branch; FHIR-41271 and FHIR-42716 were only same-commit background issues.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no current core source change is required.
